metadata.note: PLAN v3 test: package_sources (Git PKGBUILD) + warn-and-skip. Minimal bootable system with an official package (htop), one package built from a public GitHub PKGBUILD pinned by SHA (config-saver), and an impossible name (dasik-package-does-not-exist-12345) that must be skipped with a warning while the rest install. On a clean Arch VM: `dasik -v apply config/vm-unknown-git.json --yes` exits 0, `pacman -Q htop` and `pacman -Q config-saver` succeed, `pacman -Q dasik-package-does-not-exist-12345` fails (not installed), and a 2nd apply does NOT rebuild config-saver (unchanged ref). NOT for real hardware. Autologins root on ttyS0 and ships python-pydantic/python-colorama via pacman, so the driver can then check that `sync` carries the Git source back.
